units.source_text: 王命妇已迁任栉笥殿职务，

en.t: Wang Myobu had already been transferred to duties at the Kushige Hall,
and she had her own rooms there.
The Inner Minister Genji went to visit her,

units.source_text: 探问她：“那桩事情，母后在世之时是否曾向皇上泄露口风？”

en.t: and quietly asked her, "About that matter, while the Empress Mother was alive, did she ever let anything slip to His Majesty?"
Wang Myobu replied, "There was no such thing!

units.source_text: 母后非常恐惧，生怕皇上听到风声。

en.t: The Empress Mother was terribly afraid that His Majesty might hear even a rumor of it.

units.source_text: 一方面她又替皇上担心，深恐他不识亲父，蒙不孝之罪，而受神佛惩罚。”

en.t: At the same time, she worried for His Majesty, deeply fearing that if he did not know his true father, he would bear the sin of unfilial conduct and suffer punishment from the gods and Buddhas."
When the Inner Minister Genji heard this,

units.source_text: 回思藤壶母后那温厚周谨、深思远虑的模样，

en.t: he thought back on the Empress Mother Fujitsubo, so gentle, careful, and deeply prudent,
and in his heart his longing for her would not cease.
